info.description: Define custom gradient colors for light and dark modes with start, middle, end color stops

lightModeStart.description: Hex color for gradient start in light mode (e.g., #16a34a). Leave empty to use theme primary color.

lightModeMiddle.description: Hex color for gradient middle stop in light mode (e.g., #84cc16). Leave empty for automatic blend (70% opacity of start color).

lightModeEnd.description: Hex color for gradient end in light mode (e.g., #e8f5e9). Leave empty for 20% opacity of start color.

darkModeStart.description: Hex color for gradient start in dark mode (e.g., #22c55e). Leave empty to use light mode colors or theme.

darkModeMiddle.description: Hex color for gradient middle stop in dark mode. Leave empty for automatic blend (70% opacity of start color).

darkModeEnd.description: Hex color for gradient end in dark mode. Leave empty for 20% opacity of start color.
